Title: Some users may be unable to create assignments in Microsoft OneNote 

User impact: Users may be unable to create assignments in Microsoft OneNote. 

Current status: We’re investigating elevated failures affecting assignment creation in Microsoft OneNote and are monitoring the affected environments to assess the extent of impact. We're developing and testing a fix as part of our mitigation efforts. Once validation is complete, we'll begin deploying the fix across the affected environment to restore service functionality. 

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and some users attempting to create assignments in Microsoft OneNote may be impacted.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 11:30 AM UTC
